questions.scenario: You are scrolling through YouTube. Which video thumbnail would make you click immediately?

options.text: How a 21-year-old boy built a 1 crore business.
How to build an AI chatbot with just 10 lines of code.
The secret strategy behind passing new government laws.
A cheap way to save coastal cities from global warming.
The unsolved mysteries of the universe and the truth about black holes.
None of these.

questions.scenario: There is a severe water crisis in your city. How would you solve it?

options.text: Become an IAS officer and fix the city's water management laws.
Build a smart sensor app that detects water leakage.
Start a water-purification startup to deliver clean water cheaply.
Form an NGO to teach every household rainwater harvesting.
Make a documentary film on the water crisis to spread awareness on social media.
None of these.

questions.scenario: If you had the chance to sit in the chair of a top leader for a day, who would you choose to be?

options.text: The CEO of a big tech company like Google or Microsoft.
The National Security Advisor (NSA) controlling the country's policies.
A top space scientist working on a Mars mission.
A top film director or media owner deciding what the country watches.
The United Nations (UN) chief working for global peace and human rights.
None of these.

questions.scenario: What does a 'successful life' mean to you?

options.text: Bringing a massive positive change in the country, even if I remain anonymous.
Being in such a powerful position where my single signature changes thousands of lives.
Building a vast financial empire and creating global wealth.
Sharing my knowledge and shaping the future of thousands of students.
Living close to nature, finding mental peace, and leading a stress-free life.
None of these.

questions.scenario: Your group project file gets deleted the night before submission. What is your immediate reaction?

options.text: I wouldn't panic; I'd immediately sketch a rough structure to rebuild it fast.
Look for data recovery software or tech hacks to get it back.
Plan to confidently explain the situation to the teacher and ask for extra time.
Calm down the rest of the group members so nobody panics.
Tell the truth to the teacher without making excuses and accept whatever the consequence is.
None of these.

questions.scenario: The school implements a rule that is very unfair. How would you handle it?

options.text: Gather students, run a signature campaign, and protest logically.
Examine the legal aspects and the school constitution to see if the rule is valid.
Find a smart loophole or tech-trick to safely bypass this rule.
I would think about how this rule will negatively impact the mental health of weaker students.
Start an article or campaign against it on social media or in the school magazine.
None of these.

questions.scenario: During a school event, the main speaker's mic stops working. You are nearby. What do you do?

options.text: Rush immediately, check the cables and amplifier, and try to fix the technical issue.
Grab another mic and keep the audience engaged by telling a joke so they don't get bored.
Run to the backroom, coordinate with the tech team, and handle the situation.
Look at the speaker to see if they are panicking and try to calm them down.
Quickly go out and find a new mic or a megaphone from somewhere.
None of these.

questions.scenario: You have to launch a new brand. Which part of the whole process excites you the most?

options.text: Designing the logo, packaging, and a beautiful website.
Writing the script for the ad film and shooting the video.
Setting up delivery trucks and warehouses all across India.
Meeting with investors and calculating profit margins.
Interviewing and hiring talented people to build an excellent team.
None of these.

questions.scenario: If you watched a movie 6 months ago, what do you remember the most about it today?

options.text: Its exact dialogues, character names, and facts.
Beautiful camera angles, lighting, and locations.
The logical timeline and plot twists of the story.
Its background music and the emotions I felt at that time.
The social message of the film and how it changed my perspective.
None of these.

questions.scenario: When learning a complex science topic, what helps you understand it the best?

options.text: A detailed 3D animation or diagram.
The teacher explaining it with a real-life story.
Doing the experiment myself with my own hands.
Reading the definition in the book and solving the formula.
Group studying with friends and debating the topic.
None of these.

questions.scenario: You lose your house keys. How does your brain try to find them?

options.text: I close my eyes and try to visualize my movements like a CCTV camera.
I think backward using logic (e.g., if I opened the fridge, the keys must be there).
I just start physically searching everywhere without thinking too much.
I ask everyone present in the house if they have seen them.
I give up searching and immediately start thinking of calling a locksmith or another solution.
None of these.

questions.scenario: You have to work continuously for 8 hours. What kind of environment would you prefer?

options.text: Roaming around the city, meeting people, or organizing an outdoor event.
Sitting in a comfortable chair, fully focused on a laptop or books.
Working with my hands—fixing machines, crafting, or doing surgery.
Standing on a stage, speaking, and interacting with a crowd.
In a creative studio where I can do art, design, or video editing.
None of these.

questions.scenario: After a very exhausting week, how does your body demand rest?

options.text: Playing a heavy sport or sweating it out in the gym to relieve stress.
Sleeping for 10 hours or peacefully reading a book.
Going on a long drive or trekking in the midst of nature.
Gaming, watching anime, or painting.
Going out for a good party or dinner with friends or family.
None of these.

questions.scenario: How is your relationship with 'fine motor skills' (using your hands and fingers very precisely)?

options.text: I am very good at drawing, painting, or playing musical instruments.
I type very fast on a keyboard without looking.
I can open gadgets with a screwdriver and fix them easily.
I prefer using my whole body (like sports, dance) rather than fine finger work.
I am very good at cooking or baking, where measurement and decoration are important.
None of these.

questions.scenario: When there is extreme chaos, loud noise, and pressure around you, what is your body's reaction?

options.text: My adrenaline pumps up and I perform my best in that chaos.
I put on noise-canceling headphones and isolate myself completely.
I start giving orders loudly and control the crowd.
I silently observe everything before taking any step.
I immediately start creating a checklist or process to fix the system.
None of these.
